observations.posthog_connection: This change could prevent a transient, transport-layer HTTP 400 error from Bing Ads from being classified as a permanent, non-retryable failure, which could otherwise disable the Bing Ads warehouse ingestion workflow. The implementation relies on a shared utility `error_message_matches` and a classification against a set of transient error strings.
